prompt.generated_prompt_string: A vertical high-end fashion editorial portrait of an adult woman with long flowing dark hair, refined natural features, a calm detached expression, and an elegant feminine silhouette. She wears a fitted black open-back evening dress with thin straps. Place her in a mirrored bathroom or mirrored-wall interior where multiple layered reflections create depth. Her body angles slightly while her head turns toward the camera; one hand lightly touches the mirror or rests at a dark stone countertop. Keep the open-back dress, dark hair, clean counter, and reflection edges visible. Use cool-white practical mirror lighting at approximately 5600K with localized side shadow for structural contours, dimensional reflections, controlled dress highlights, and gentle reflection softness. Sony A7R V, 50mm f/1.8, slight low or side angle, vertical full-body composition, low contrast, subtle film grain, natural skin texture, and softly layered reflections.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, body measurements, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, text, logo, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: The source moodboard is optional and preserves the fitted black open-back dress, long dark hair, mirrored bathroom, counter, hand placement, and cool-white reflection lighting. An approved-adult face reference may replace the subject; preserve her face, facial structure, and likeness. The exact room may be changed while retaining mirror layers and a restrained cool editorial mood.
